t: 康斯坦丁·汉克利(Constantine Hangerli)抵达了瓦拉几亚的布加勒斯特,作为由…

de: Constantine Hangerli arrives in Bucharest, Wallachia, as its new Prince, invested by the Ottoman Empire.

dz: 罗马共和国是在拿破仑的将领路易-亚历山大·贝蒂埃五天前入侵罗马城后宣布的.
de: The Roman Republic is proclaimed after Louis-Alexandre Berthier, a general of Napoleon, had invaded the city of Rome five days earlier.

t: 路易-亚历山大·贝蒂埃解除了教宗皮乌斯六世的权力.
te: Louis-Alexandre Berthier removes Pope Pius VI from power.
dz: 路易-亚历山大·贝蒂埃解除了教宗皮乌斯六世的权力.
de: Louis-Alexandre Berthier removes Pope Pius VI from power.

t: 密西西比领地的组织来自美国和西班牙帝国共同主张的争议领土. 1804年扩建,1812年再扩建.
te: The Mississippi Territory is organized from disputed territory claimed by both the United States and the Spanish Empire…
dz: 密西西比领地的组织来自美国和西班牙帝国共同主张的争议领土. 1804年扩建,1812年再扩建.
de: The Mississippi Territory is organized from disputed territory claimed by both the United States and the Spanish Empire. It is expanded in 1804 and again in 1812.

te: A French force attempting to dislodge a small British garrison on the Îles Saint-Marcouf is repulsed with heavy losses.
dz: 法国革命战争：一支法国军队试图驱逐圣马库夫岛上的一小支英国驻军，但被击退，损失惨重。

dz: 拿破仑·波拿巴和他的远征军出走法国入侵埃及.

te: The Irish Rebellion of 1798 led by the United Irishmen against British rule begins.
dz: 由爱尔兰联合人所领导的1798年爱尔兰人反抗英国统治的叛乱开始.

te: Battle of Carlow begins; executions of suspected rebels at Carnew and at Dunlavin Green take place.
dz: 爱尔兰联合人起义:卡洛战役开始;在卡纽和邓拉文格林处决被怀疑是叛军的人.

t: 欧拉特山战役(Battle of Oulart Hill)发生在爱尔兰韦克斯福德;爱尔兰叛军领…
te: The Battle of Oulart Hill takes place in Wexford, Ireland; Irish rebel leaders defeat and kill a detachment of militia.
dz: 欧拉特山战役(Battle of Oulart Hill)发生在爱尔兰韦克斯福德;爱尔兰叛军领导人击败并杀死了一支民兵分遣队.
de: The Battle of Oulart Hill takes place in Wexford, Ireland; Irish rebel leaders defeat and kill a detachment of militia.

t: Pitt–Tierney决斗在伦敦外的Putney Heath上进行. 大不列颠首相威廉·皮特…
te: The Pitt–Tierney duel takes place on Putney Heath outside London. A bloodless duel between the prime minister of Great …
dz: Pitt–Tierney决斗在伦敦外的Putney Heath上进行. 大不列颠首相威廉·皮特(英语:William Pitt the Younger)与他的政治对手乔治·蒂尔尼(英语:George Tierney)的无血战.
de: The Pitt–Tierney duel takes place on Putney Heath outside London. A bloodless duel between the prime minister of Great Britain William Pitt the Younger and his political opponent George Tierney.

t: 300至500名爱尔兰联合人被英军在爱尔兰郡基尔达雷作为叛军处决.
te: Between 300 and 500 United Irishmen are executed as rebels by the British Army in County Kildare, Ireland.

de: United Irishmen Rebellion: Between 300 and 500 United Irishmen are executed as rebels by the British Army in County Kildare, Ireland.

te: The attempt to spread the United Irish Rebellion into Munster is defeated.
dz: 新罗斯之战:企图将爱尔兰联合叛乱蔓延到芒斯特被击败.
de: Battle of New Ross: The attempt to spread the United Irish Rebellion into Munster is defeated.

t: 1798年爱尔兰起义:阿克洛和圣菲尔德之战.
te: Battles of Arklow and Saintfield.
dz: 1798年爱尔兰起义:阿克洛和圣菲尔德之战.

t: 1798年爱尔兰起义:巴利纳欣奇战役.

t: 由于"XYZ Affair",美国国会撤销了与法国的"同盟条约",引发了"准战争".
te: As a result of the XYZ Affair, the US Congress rescinds the Treaty of Alliance with France sparking the "Quasi-War".
dz: 由于"XYZ Affair",美国国会撤销了与法国的"同盟条约",引发了"准战争".
de: As a result of the XYZ Affair, the US Congress rescinds the Treaty of Alliance with France sparking the "Quasi-War".

te: The United States Marine Corps is re-established; they had been disbanded after the American Revolutionary War.
dz: 美国海军陆战队重新成立；他们在美国独立战争后被解散。
de: The United States Marine Corps is re-established; they had been disbanded after the American Revolutionary War.

t: 拿破仑·波拿巴手下的法国东方军团在舒布拉克希特战役中击败了穆拉德·贝伊手下的一支马姆卢克军队.
te: The French Armée d'Orient under Napoleon Bonaparte defeats a Mamluk army under Murad Bey in battle of Shubra Khit.
dz: 拿破仑·波拿巴手下的法国东方军团在舒布拉克希特战役中击败了穆拉德·贝伊手下的一支马姆卢克军队.
de: The French Armée d'Orient under Napoleon Bonaparte defeats a Mamluk army under Murad Bey in battle of Shubra Khit.

t: 1798年的"煽动法"在美国成为了法律,将写作,发表,或发表关于美国政府的虚假或恶意言论定为联…
te: The Sedition Act of 1798 becomes law in the United States making it a federal crime to write, publish, or utter false o…
dz: 1798年的"煽动法"在美国成为了法律,将写作,发表,或发表关于美国政府的虚假或恶意言论定为联邦罪行.
de: The Sedition Act of 1798 becomes law in the United States making it a federal crime to write, publish, or utter false or malicious statements about the United States government.

t: 拿破仑的军队在开罗附近击败了一支奥斯曼-曼卢克军队,在平顶山战役中被击败.
te: Napoleon's forces defeat an Ottoman-Mamluk army near Cairo in the Battle of the Pyramids.
dz: 法国在埃及和叙利亚的战役:拿破仑的军队在开罗附近击败了一支奥斯曼-曼卢克军队,在平顶山战役中被击败.
de: French campaign in Egypt and Syria: Napoleon's forces defeat an Ottoman-Mamluk army near Cairo in the Battle of the Pyramids.

te: Battle of the Nile (Battle of Aboukir Bay): Battle begins when a British fleet engages the French Revolutionary Navy fl…
dz: 法国革命战争：尼罗河战役（阿布基尔湾海战）：当英国舰队在一次不寻常的夜间行动中与法国革命海军舰队交战时，战斗开始。
de: French Revolutionary Wars: Battle of the Nile (Battle of Aboukir Bay): Battle begins when a British fleet engages the French Revolutionary Navy fleet in an unusual night action.

t: 尼罗河战役以英国的胜利而结束。
te: The Battle of the Nile concludes in a British victory.
dz: 法国革命战争：尼罗河战役以英国的胜利而结束。

t: 越南天主教徒报告了在 Quảng Trị 发生的圣母显现事件，这一事件被称为“La Vang …
te: The Vietnamese Catholics report a Marian apparition in Quảng Trị, an event which is called Our Lady of La Vang.
dz: 越南天主教徒报告了在 Quảng Trị 发生的圣母显现事件，这一事件被称为“La Vang 圣母”。
de: The Vietnamese Catholics report a Marian apparition in Quảng Trị, an event which is called Our Lady of La Vang.

t: 法国军队在爱尔兰马约县克勒克明登陆以援助叛乱.
te: French troops land at Kilcummin, County Mayo, Ireland to aid the rebellion.
dz: 法国军队在爱尔兰马约县克勒克明登陆以援助叛乱.

t: 沃尔夫·通(英语:Wolfe Tone)的爱尔兰和法国联合军在1798年爱尔兰起义的一部分卡塞…
te: Wolfe Tone's United Irish and French forces clash with the British Army in the Battle of Castlebar, part of the Irish R…
dz: 沃尔夫·通(英语:Wolfe Tone)的爱尔兰和法国联合军在1798年爱尔兰起义的一部分卡塞尔巴尔战役中与英国军队相冲突,导致法国傀儡康纳克特共和国的建立.
de: Wolfe Tone's United Irish and French forces clash with the British Army in the Battle of Castlebar, part of the Irish Rebellion of 1798, resulting in the creation of the French puppet Republic of Connacht.

t: 爱尔兰叛军在法国的协助下建立了短暂的康纳克特共和国.
te: Irish rebels, with French assistance, establish the short-lived Republic of Connacht.
dz: 爱尔兰叛乱:爱尔兰叛军在法国的协助下建立了短暂的康纳克特共和国.

te: The week long battle of St. George's Caye begins between Spain and Britain off the coast of Belize.
dz: 周长的圣乔治卡耶战役从西班牙和英国在伯利兹近海开始.
de: The week long battle of St. George's Caye begins between Spain and Britain off the coast of Belize.

t: 在法国,《Jourdan法》强制征兵.
te: Conscription is made mandatory in France by the Jourdan law.
dz: 在法国,《Jourdan法》强制征兵.
de: Conscription is made mandatory in France by the Jourdan law.

t: 弗拉芒和卢森堡农民发动了反抗被称作"农民战争"的法国统治的叛乱.

dz: 弗拉芒和卢森堡农民发动了反抗被称作"农民战争"的法国统治的叛乱.

de: The forces of Ali Pasha of Janina defeat the French and capture the town of Preveza in the Battle of Nicopolis.

te: The Russo-Ottoman siege of Corfu begins.
dz: 鲁索-奥托曼围攻科孚开始.
de: The Russo-Ottoman siege of Corfu begins.

t: 美国和现代乌拉圭之间的贸易始于约翰·莱米的"约翰"号护卫舰抵达蒙得维的亚.
te: Trade between the United States and modern-day Uruguay begins when John Leamy's frigate John arrives in Montevideo.
